claim: Domain-specific knowledge injection causes a degradation in general capabilities due to domain shift.
falsifier: Inject domain-specific knowledge into a general LLM via post-training and measure performance on a general benchmark before and after; verify a decrease attributable to domain shift.

conditions: domain shift between general and domain-specific data
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system (FitOne-8B based on Qwen3-8B), task (SFC certification exams vs. General-Bench), and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Domain-specific knowledge injection–general capabilities boundary
